title: Dachshund Dog Tags for Long, Low Burrowers | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny engraved dachshund dog tags for long dogs with short patience. Laser engraved in Lehi, Utah, with your dog's name and number on the back. From $12.
blurb: Engraved tags for a long dog with short patience. Dachshunds were bred to go after badgers and now spend their days going after blankets, crumbs and the mail carrier.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Built for burrowing, barking and belly-dragging
tough.html:
A dachshund's tag rides lower than almost any breed's. It drags under blankets, scrapes through grass and gets wedged into every couch cushion they tunnel into.

We laser-cut the text into the metal. Nothing printed on top, so the phone number survives the burrowing.

The dog is long. The tag is short and to the point.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Bulldogs and dachshunds agree on one thing: stairs are a scam. The dachshund lines come from friends with doxies who bark at our bulldogs from behind the fence.

items.q: Will burrowing and dragging wear off the engraving?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top.

items.q: Can I put my dachshund's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes. Saying on the front, name and phone number on the back.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for dachshunds?
items.a: Eight on this page, about the length, the barking and the stairs. Each fits the tag as written.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
